title: Heavy systems removed, build green
done_when: three, gsap-driven sections, public/1 frames, perf/ are gone; init.sh exits 0; dist/ has only index, fonts, icons, projects

title: Design tokens and base typography
done_when: tokens.scss defines the spec palette and scale; global CSS < 8 KB; focus ring visible; reduced-motion sets --dur to 0

title: Base layout with nav, footer, view transitions, reveal
done_when: dist/index.html preloads the two fonts, contains ClientRouter output, nav has 3 links and no burger

title: Work content collection
done_when: src/content.config.ts schema validates; TouchPoint, SPOOT, Remote Lab Vision entries build; AMS, Rocket, Clinic are draft and absent from dist

title: Hero
done_when: name does not wrap mid-word at 390px; hero line is the owner's exact sentence; screenshots reviewed

title: Work list with hover preview
done_when: rows render from the collection; follower shows/swaps/hides in Playwright; rAF stops after leave; inline covers on coarse pointer only; keyboard reaches every row with a visible ring

title: Project pages
done_when: dist/work/<slug>/index.html for the three live projects; one h1 each; meta, prose sections, gallery, next link render; view transition list->page->back works in Chromium

title: About and contact
done_when: copy follows the spec rules; contrast of muted ink >= 4.5:1 (axe); email is a mailto link at title size

title: Media pipeline
done_when: scripts/media.mjs produces cover/thumb/gallery webp for three slugs; public/projects <= 15 MB; every img on every page has naturalWidth > 0

title: QA gate
done_when: 0 console errors Chromium+WebKit desktop+mobile; axe 0 serious/critical; Lighthouse mobile perf >= 95 and a11y 100; client JS <= 12 KB gz; screenshots reviewed

title: Preview reachable and branch pushed
done_when: https://vps-worker.taild24189.ts.net:8447 serves the production build from tmux; redesign/minimal pushed; owner has the link and the safari-gate list

title: Code review passed
done_when: /code-review on main..redesign/minimal has no open blocker or major; /simplify applied
